mapper.select: SELECT ac.participant_pin AS pin, py.year AS program_year, cl.program_year_margin, cl.adjusted_reference_margin AS reference_margin, sc.scenario_category_code, scat.description AS scenario_category, COALESCE(cl.bnft_after_late_enrol_penalty, cl.benefit_after_payment_cap, cl.benefit_after_interim_ded, cl.benefit_after_prod_insur_ded, cl.benefit_before_deductions) AS whole_farm_benefit, cl.benefit_after_prod_insur_ded - cl.benefit_before_deductions AS deemed_pi_deduction, cl.applied_benefit_percent AS combined_percent, cl.benefit_after_appl_benefit_pct AS benefit_after_combined_percent, cl.enh_additional_benefit AS bc_enhancement, cl.interim_benefit_percent AS interim_payment_percentage, cl.late_enrolment_penalty, CASE WHEN COALESCE(cl.benefit_after_interim_ded, cl.benefit_after_prod_insur_ded, cl.benefit_before_deductions) > cl.payment_cap THEN cl.benefit_after_payment_cap END AS payment_limitation_amount FROM farms.farm_agristability_clients ac JOIN farms.farm_program_years py ON py.agristability_client_id = ac.agristability_client_id JOIN farms.farm_program_year_versions pyv ON pyv.program_year_id = py.program_year_id JOIN farms.farm_agristability_scenarios sc ON sc.program_year_version_id = pyv.program_year_version_id JOIN farms.farm_agristability_claims cl ON cl.agristability_scenario_id = sc.agristability_scenario_id JOIN farms.farm_scenario_category_codes scat ON scat.scenario_category_code = sc.scenario_category_code WHERE ac.participant_pin = #{participantPin} AND py.year = #{programYear} AND sc.scenario_number = #{scenarioNumber} ORDER BY pyv.program_year_version_id
